evals.prompt: /test-suite Add tests for the discount code validation logic in src/billing/discounts.py
assertions: Reads the source file before writing tests and follows the project's existing test framework and conventions
Covers the happy path, edge cases (expired or invalid codes), and error paths — not just trivial getters
Does not add snapshot tests or assert-nothing tests purely to move a coverage number
All generated tests pass and the full suite has no regressions
Runs a coverage baseline first and prioritizes untested or critical code paths
Skips trivial pass-through functions and pure getters/setters
Includes tests for the token-expiration and invalid-signature paths rather than skipping security-relevant paths for convenience
Presents a test plan for approval before generating tests
